title: I asked AI to draw ONE banana 🍌

beats.big:
Draw me
ONE banana.
Just one.
beats.say: I asked AI to draw one banana. Just one.
Here's your banana. It is two bananas.
Okay. One banana. Alone. Still two bananas.
Fine. A monkey holding a single banana. The monkey has two bananas.
A scientist who tried this in Midjourney called it the lone banana problem. Every image had two or more.

beats.sub: one theory: so do the training photos
beats.say: One theory: the AI learned from photos where bananas almost always come in bunches.

beats.big:
So it can't
imagine
just one.
beats.sub: try it yourself. how many did you get?
beats.say: So it can't imagine just one. Try it yourself, and tell me how many you got.
